title: Constructible complete proper base change
statement:
Use the adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] with $A=\mathcal O_E$, $I=(\varpi)$ for a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and the full categories $\Dbc(T_{\Proet},A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be the cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $X,Y,X',Y'$ noetherian of finite dimension, $f$ and $f'$ proper, a positive integer $N$ annihilating $A/I$ invertible on all four schemes, and geometric fibers of $f$ of dimension at most $e\geq0$, as in [prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible]. Then the specified completed exchange [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map] restricts to a natural isomorphism of ordinary triangulated functors
$$
 Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*(-)
 \xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}(-)
 :\Dbc(X_{\Proet},A)\longrightarrow\Dbc(Y'_{\Proet},A),
$$
where completed pullback is [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Its component at each $K$ is exactly the isomorphism of [thm-weil-pbc-complete-proetale]. The coefficient category here is the completed $A_T$-module category of the cited definitions, without an identification with a condensed rational-coefficient category.

[prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible].

proof.text: Take $K$ in the full subcategory [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. It is derived complete and has compatible witnesses $L_n\in D^+(X_{\Et},P_n)$ with $\nu_X^*L_n\simeq K_n$, including the quotient cocycle. Hence the hypotheses on $K$ in [thm-weil-pbc-complete-proetale] are satisfied. Properness and the adic coefficient hypotheses are among the assumptions. That theorem gives invertibility of the specified completed exchange $\eta_K$.

source.place: ## Proof; agent expansion, with Stacks 09C9 (proetale-theorem-proper-base-change) as constant-coefficient context

proof.text: To verify the extra uniform-interval hypothesis of preservation rather than infer it from levelwise boundedness, use [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower] for local models in degrees $[d_0,d_1]$. By [lem-weil-pbc-uniform-perfect-quotient-bound] choose resolutions $Q_n$ of $P_n$ in degrees $[-r,0]$ with one $r$ for all $n$. The flat constant-to-completed comparison and finite-quotient identification in [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence] make the sheafified $Q_n\otimes_A A_X$ resolutions of $(P_n)_X$ by flat $A_X$-modules. On each supplied stratum covering the derived reduction is thus represented by the total tensor of the local complex with this bounded flat resolution; all summands in degree $q$ vanish unless $d_0-r\leq q\leq d_1$. The reduction isomorphisms and locality for the pro-etale covering of each stratum, clause (1) of [lem-cbc-proetale-stalk-conservative], give vanishing outside this interval after restriction to every stratum. Each geometric point of $X$ factors through its unique stratum, so the geometric-point cohomology stalks of $K_n$ vanish outside this interval. To deduce global vanishing, use the bounded-below etale-origin witness $K_n\simeq\nu_X^*L_n$ already supplied in step 1: each cohomology sheaf is of etale origin because inverse image is exact. Apply clause (3) of [lem-cbc-proetale-stalk-conservative] to the map from zero to that degree-zero cohomology sheaf. This gives a common interval $[a,b]=[d_0-r,d_1]$ for all $K_n$. This argument uses etale origin; the strata are not asserted to be a pro-etale covering of $X$.

source.place: ## Proof; agent expansion, with Stacks 09C9 (proetale-theorem-proper-base-change) as constant-coefficient context

proof.text: Apply [prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible] to this interval: the four objects $Rf_*K$, $Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K$, $Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$, and $Rf'_*Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$ are in the indicated bounded constructible complete categories. In particular both endpoints of $\eta_K$ are in the full subcategory on $Y'$.

source.place: ## Proof; agent expansion, with Stacks 09C9 (proetale-theorem-proper-base-change) as constant-coefficient context

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-uniform-complete-triangulated] these full categories have the inherited triangulation. For the reduction-tower functor, [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] supplies K-flat replacements and preservation of quasi-isomorphisms between them. For tower pullback use [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-kflat-replacements] with the small indexing category $J=\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}$ and the coefficient structure map $c_g$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]: it supplies strict objectwise K-flat replacements with flat terms and says that pullback carries quasi-isomorphisms between these replacements to objectwise quasi-isomorphisms. Termwise tensor and module pullback commute with integer shifts and with the two finite direct summands and signed differential defining a cone. Thus their homotopy-category functors are exact, and both resolving-class hypotheses of [lem-pur-left-derived-from-kflat-class] hold. That theorem makes their total left derived functors exact. Their composition with the triangulated $\Rlim$ of [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality] is therefore triangulated. The module direct images along the completed coefficient structure maps are additive termwise functors, so their K-injective total right derived functors are triangulated by [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated]. Thus the two displayed composites are exact. The object preservation of step 3 restricts them on objects; on morphisms retain the ambient maps. Functor identities, the shift isomorphisms, and preservation of distinguished triangles hold after restriction because the subcategories are full and their triangles are inherited.

source.place: ## Proof; agent expansion, with Stacks 09C9 (proetale-theorem-proper-base-change) as constant-coefficient context

proof.text: By [lemma-weil-pbc-completed-exchange-coherence], for every morphism $u:K\to L$, $G(u)\eta_K=\eta_LF(u)$, where $F=Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*$ and $G=Rf'_*Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}$. Fullness in [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] makes this same equality the naturality square in the restricted categories. The ambient inverse $\eta_K^{-1}$ also belongs to that full subcategory. Multiplying the displayed equality on the left by $\eta_L^{-1}$ and on the right by $\eta_K^{-1}$ yields $F(u)\eta_K^{-1}=\eta_L^{-1}G(u)$; the two inverse identities remain the ambient identities. These maps form the asserted natural isomorphism between the ordinary exact functors of step 4; no enhanced or functorial-cone construction is being inferred from objectwise isomorphisms.

split_report.summary: Expanded preservation and objectwise complete base change into a functor-level restriction. Checked compatible witnesses against the reviewed category definition, supplied the uniform reduction interval using the existing quotient bound and flat coefficient comparison, cited naturality, and separated the missing closure theorem for the stronger uniform tower category. Explicit hypotheses and completed coefficient category are unchanged in meaning.
